idea-plugin.name: Parquet Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Parquet Viewer 2.0 - The Ultimate Parquet Tool for Geeks!

Parquet Viewer is a lightweight, high-performance IntelliJ IDEA plugin that allows you to open, explore, and analyze .parquet files directly within your IDE.
Version 2.0 brings a completely rewritten core engine and a stunning new UI designed for big data professionals.

🚀 Extreme Performance (New Engine):
  • Instant Open: Reads metadata in O(1) time. Opens GB-sized files instantly without scanning the whole file.
  • Smart Pagination: Implements Row Group Skipping. Flipping to page 10,000 is now as fast as page 1.
  • Column Projection: Only reads the columns you select, drastically reducing memory usage and IO.
✨ Geeky Features:
  • X-Ray Schema Tree: View deep stats like Compression Ratio, Null %, and Compressed Size directly in the schema view.
  • Code Generation: Right-click any schema node to instantly generate Hive DDL or Java POJO code.
  • Hex / Raw View: Right-click data cells to inspect binary data, debug encoding issues, or view raw hex dumps.
  • Metadata Inspector: A dedicated tab to view file properties, creator info, and user-defined key-values.
🎨 Modern UI Experience:
  • Native Integration: Redesigned with IntelliJ native icons, colors, and JetBrains Mono font support.
  • Enhanced Data Grid: Features Excel-style Row Headers (line numbers), Zebra Striping, and explicit <null> rendering.
  • Seamless UX: Improved drag-and-drop support, flat toolbar buttons, and responsive controls.
Core Features:
  • Schema view (Switchable between Tree & Text modes).
  • Data preview with advanced filtering (MVEL syntax support).
  • Column selector to hide irrelevant fields.
  • Export filtered results to CSV and JSON.
  • Full Dark Mode support.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0 - The Major "Geek" Update

This version is a complete rewrite focusing on performance and developer productivity.
  • 🚀 Performance Overhaul: Implemented Row Group Skipping and Column Projection. Large files (GBs) now open and scroll instantly.
  • 🧬 Advanced Schema View: The schema tree now displays "geeky" stats: Compression Ratio, Null Percentage, and Size per column.
  • 💻 Code Generation: Added context menu to generate Hive DDL and Java POJO directly from the schema.
  • 🧐 Hex Viewer: Added "View as Hex / Raw" to data cells for debugging binary data.
  • 🎨 UI Redesign:
    • Added Row Numbers (Excel-style) to the data table.
    • Updated to use native IntelliJ icons and flat toolbar buttons.
    • Unified fonts (JetBrains Mono) and explicit <null> rendering.
  • ℹ️ Metadata Tab: Added a new tab to view detailed file metadata and key-value pairs.
  • 🐛 Improvements: Fixed drag-and-drop issues on input fields, optimized memory usage, and fixed pagination button logic.
